bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 11月5日低点 $51.5

read.en: Intel fell 8.0% on Nov 20 to $51.28, its lowest close since Apr 6, trading $51.10–56.48 on heavy volume (1.40x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($54.5), 10-day ($57.3), 30-day ($74.5) and 100-day ($94.3), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($87.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 18, below zero, histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($66.94), and RSI is 28.0, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月20日下跌 8.0%，收于 $51.28，为 4月6日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $51.10–56.48，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.40 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$54.5）、10 日（$57.3）、30 日（$74.5）和 100 日均线（$94.3）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$87.6）。MACD 自 11月18日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$66.94），RSI 为 28.0，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $52.4–54.9 (Nov 17–19 lows) and the $51.51 Nov 5 low, now resistance. Resistance is $51.5–52.4, then $54.5–56.5 (5-day, Jan 22 high, Nov 20 high) and $57.3–58.1 (10-day). Support is $49.2–51.1 (Nov 20 low, Mar 16 high, $50), then $47–47.9 (February and March highs) and $45.5. A close above $52.4 would target $54.5–56.5; below $49.2, $47–47.9.

r.en: Nov 5 low $51.51, lost; Nov 5 close $52.25; Nov 17 low $52.42

s.en: Nov 20 low $51.10; round number $50; Mar 16 high $49.17
